        row_id STRING NOT NULL,
        score DOUBLE,
        CONSTRAINT predictions7b586d_pk PRIMARY KEY (row_id)
    )
    USING DELTA
""")

    .saveAsTable("workspace.mlpab6c8eeb.predictions7b586d")
